sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS PORTIONS NRN PLAINS
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... INTENSE MID-UPPER ANTICYCLONE OVER ARKLATEX REGION WILL REMAIN DOMINANT FEATURE OVER SRN HALF OF CONUS...AS ITS CENTER DRIFTS WWD ACROSS N TX. MEANWHILE...QUASI-ZONAL BELT OF NRN STREAM FLOW WILL PERSIST FROM PAC NW TO UPPER GREAT LAKES...WITH SEVERAL EMBEDDED SHORTWAVES. MOST OF THESE WILL BE LOW-AMPLITUDE IN NATURE...EXCEPT FOR TROUGHING NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER INTERIOR NWRN CONUS. LEADING ASSOCIATED VORTICITY MAX OVER ID SHOULD BECOME PRIMARY 500-MB PERTURBATION DAY-1...MOVING EWD ACROSS MT AND REACHING ND BY END OF PERIOD. MEANWHILE...CONVECTIVELY INDUCED/AMPLIFIED VORTICITY MAX OVER MID MS VALLEY REGION SHOULD DEAMPLIFY GRADUALLY AS IT MOVES EWD TOWARD OH BY 5/00Z...WHILE MCV OVER SERN AL/SWRN GA AREA DRIFTS SWWD ACROSS CENTRAL GULF COAST. ANOTHER MCV...EVOLVING FROM CONVECTION ACROSS WRN KS...IS EXPECTED TO MOVE EWD GENERALLY TOWARD MKC AREA AND NRN MO THROUGH PERIOD. AT SFC...FRONTAL ZONE NOW QUASISTATIONARY OVER ND IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN SO THROUGH 6/00Z...WITH SOME EFFECTIVE MODULATION POSSIBLE IN RESPONSE TO INTERVENING CONVECTION. AS MID-UPPER TROUGH MOVES OVER NRN HIGH PLAINS DURING LATTER HALF OF PERIOD...DEEPENING LEE CYCLONE OVER MT

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS SHOULD DEVELOP OVER PORTIONS CENTRAL/ERN MT DURING AFTERNOON AND MOVE EWD...WITH MIXTURE OF SUPERCELL AND MULTICELL MODES INITIALLY POSSIBLE. ACTIVITY SHOULD GROW UPSCALE TO MCS WITH PRIMARY THREAT EVOLVING TO DAMAGING WIND IN CORRIDOR FROM ERN MT NOT PORTIONS ND THROUGH EVENING AND EARLY OVERNIGHT HOURS. SVR POTENTIAL THEN SHOULD DIMINISH LATE NIGHT AS CONVECTION ENCOUNTERS PROGRESSIVELY WEAKER BOUNDARY-LAYER INSTABILITY...BOTH WITH TIME AND WITH EWD EXTENT. AFTERNOON INITIATION IS FCST IN REGIME OF FAVORABLY STEEP MIDDLE-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AIDED BY DCVA ALOFT...INCREASING MOISTURE WITH EWD EXTENT...FRONTAL/CYCLONIC CONVERGENCE NEAR SFC LOW...DIABATIC SFC HEATING TO STEEPEN SUBCLOUD LAPSE RATES AND CONTRIBUTE TO CINH REMOVAL...FAVORABLE STORM-RELATIVE INFLOW...AND ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL VORTICITY INVOF FRONT. GIVEN THIS ANTICIPATED JUXTAPOSITION OF FAVORABLE FOCI AND PARAMETERS...STG CONSENSUS EXISTS AMONG OPERATIONAL MODELS AND SREF MEMBERS WITH CONCENTRATED AREA OF CONVECTIVE PRECIP MOVING EWD FROM MT TO SD FROM AFTERNOON THROUGH EVENING. AGGREGATE OUTFLOW MAY RESULT IN FORWARD-PROPAGATING MCS ALIGNED NEARLY ORTHOGONAL TO DEEP-LAYER WIND VECTOR IN SUPPORT OF WIND POTE

sections.title: CENTRAL PLAINS TO SERN CONUS
sections.text: WIDELY SCATTERED TO SCATTERED TSTMS ARE POSSIBLE AGAIN THIS AFTERNOON...WITH ASSORTED FOCI INCLUDING SEA BREEZES/OUTFLOWS NEAR ATLC AND GULF COASTS...OUTFLOW/DIFFERENTIAL HEATING BOUNDARIES NEAR RESIDUAL CLOUD COVER OVER PORTIONS MS/AL OR MID-SOUTH REGIONS...AND ALONG AND N OF FRONTAL ZONE AND RESIDUAL OUTFLOWS FROM PRIOR/OVERNIGHT CONVECTION FROM OZARKS INTO CENTRAL PLAINS. RELATIVE NODES OR MAXIMA ARE PROBABLE WITHIN THIS BROAD SWATH...WHICH WILL BE UNDER GENERALLY WEAK DEEP-TROPOSPHERIC FLOW AND SHEAR IN SUPPORT OF MULTICELLULAR AND PULSE MODES. SUCH NODES ARE SO DEPENDENT ON MESOSCALE FOCI -- SOME YET TO DEVELOP -- THAT THERE IS TOO MUCH UNCERTAINTY ATTM FOR UNCONDITIONAL/15% THRESHOLD CATEGORICAL RISK AREA. ONE AREA OF CONCERN IN PARTICULAR MAY BE FROM SRN KS ACROSS SRN MO...WHERE FRONTAL AND DIABATIC ASCENT MAY COMBINE WITH ENHANCED GRADIENT FLOW S OF MCV. SHAPE/DENSITY EWD-MOVING CLOUD DEBRIS FROM ONGOING CONVECTIVE REGIME OVER WRN KS MAY EXERT CONSIDERABLE INFLUENCE ON MORE PRECISE AREAS FOR CONVECTIVE/SVR POTENTIAL. ..EDWARDS/GRAMS.. 08/05/2011

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS THROUGH EARLY TONIGHT
sections.text: A COMPLEX MID-UPPER TROUGH WITH SEVERAL EMBEDDED VORTICITY MAXIMA WILL EJECT ENEWD FROM THE NRN ROCKIES TO THE NRN HIGH PLAINS. ASSOCIATED LEE CYCLOGENESIS WILL OCCUR ACROSS E/SE MT TODAY...AND THE LOW WILL MOVE INTO WRN ND OVERNIGHT. ONE POSSIBLE COMPLICATING FACTOR WILL BE THE PRESENCE OF SCATTERED ONGOING THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS WY/MT/ND...AND THE IMPACT OF THE RELATIVELY EARLY CONVECTION ON INSTABILITY THIS AFTERNOON. HOWEVER...THE MORNING STORM COVERAGE IS NOT PARTICULARLY WIDESPREAD...AND 12Z REGIONAL SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THAT SURFACE TEMPERATURES WILL NEED TO WARM INTO THE 80S BEFORE SURFACE-BASED CONVECTION WILL BECOME MORE WIDESPREAD. SURFACE HEATING IN CLOUD BREAKS AND BOUNDARY LAYER DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 50/LOWER 60S WILL SUPPORT AFTERNOON MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 1500 J/KG. DEEP-LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS...THOUGH SOMEWHAT BACKED FLOW ALOFT AND FOCUSED ASCENT WITH THE MID-UPPER TROUGH MAY TEND TO SUPPORT MORE LINE SEGMENTS AS OPPOSED TO DISCRETE CELLS INTO ERN MT. FOR THESE REASONS...DAMAGING GUSTS APPEAR TO BE THE MAIN SEVERE THREAT...IN ADDITION TO THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL.

sections.title: LOWER MO/MID MS VALLEY REGION TODAY
sections.text: A REMNANT MCS AND ASSOCIATED MCV WILL MOVE EWD/ENEWD FROM THE NE KS/SE NEB/NW MO AREA TODAY. SOME REGENERATION OF STORMS ON THE MCS OUTFLOW WILL BE POSSIBLE TODAY AS THE LOW-LEVELS WARM/DESTABILIZE...WHERE A FEW DAMAGING GUSTS WOULD BE THE MAIN SEVERE THREAT WITH PRECIPITATION LOADING AND STEEPENING LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. OTHER STORM CLUSTERS MAY FORM/PERSIST ALONG THE REMNANT NW-SE FRONT FROM ERN MO INTO WRN TN/KY...WITH A FEW DOWNBURSTS POSSIBLE MAINLY THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: REMAINDER OF THE GULF COAST/SE ATLANTIC STATES THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: RELATIVELY WIDESPREAD CONVECTION YESTERDAY APPEARS TO HAVE REDUCED INSTABILITY SOME ACROSS MS/AL. HOWEVER...SURFACE HEATING IN CLOUD BREAKS WILL ALLOW DESTABILIZATION THROUGH THIS AFTERNOON FROM MS/AL TO SC. ISOLATED STRONG DOWNBURSTS WILL REMAIN POSSIBLE IN THIS CORRIDOR...THOUGH NO CLEAR FOCUS IS APPARENT AT THIS TIME. ..THOMPSON/ROGERS.. 08/05/2011

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: A ROBUST LEAD WAVE...EMBEDDED WITHIN A LARGER-SCALE DISTURBANCE OVER THE NWRN STATES...IS EXPECTED TO EJECT ENEWD ACROSS THE NRN HIGH PLAINS THIS AFTN/EVE. ATTENDANT LEE LOW WILL EVOLVE OVER SERN MT AND MIGRATE INTO WRN ND OVERNIGHT. COMPLEX PATTERN HAS EVOLVED OVER THE REGION WITH MULTIPLE AREAS OF POSSIBLE DEEP MOIST CONVECTION. ASCENT TIED TO THE LEAD WAVE SHOULD BEGIN TO IMPINGE ON A WEAK FRONT SITUATED SW-NE ACROSS ND EARLY THIS AFTN. THIS SHOULD CONTRIBUTE TO AN UPTICK IN DEEP MOIST CONVECTION WITHIN THIS ZONE THROUGH THE AFTN. INSTABILITY SHOULD GRADUALLY IMPROVE ALONG/S OF THE BOUNDARY AND AS TEMPERATURES APPROACH THE 80S...SFC-BASED STORMS/POSSIBLE SUPERCELLS WILL DEVELOP WITH RISKS FOR LARGE HAIL AND SVR WIND GUSTS. MEANWHILE...ADDITIONAL STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO FORM UPSTREAM NEAR THE LEE LOW AND PRONOUNCED MOIST UPSLOPE FLOW ACROSS ERN MT. FCST SOUNDINGS SUGGEST THAT HOTTEST BOUNDARY LAYER SHOULD EVOLVE FROM SERN MT INTO NWRN SD AND SWRN ND LATE THIS AFTN AMIDST UPR 50S TO MID 60S SFC DEW POINTS. ROBUST INSTABILITY AND AT LEAST 40 KTS OF WSWLY MID-LEVEL FLOW WILL RESULT IN SUPERCELLULAR VERTICAL WIND PROFILES WITH LARGE HAIL...ESPECIALLY WITH INFANT STORMS. QUICK EVOLUTIO

sections.title: NRN/CENTRAL MS AND SERN AR
sections.text: RECENT RUNS OF THE EXPERIMENTAL WRF-HRRR CONTINUED TO INDICATE AN INCREASE IN TSTM DEVELOPMENT ACROSS NRN MS THIS AFTERNOON WITH COLD POOLS RESULTING IN A SWD MOVEMENT OF THE ACTIVITY TOWARD CENTRAL MS THROUGH THE LATE AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. GIVEN THESE MODEL TRENDS...THE SLIGHT RISK AREA HAS BEEN EXPANDED SWD TO INCLUDE THE REST OF THE NRN HALF OF MS AND FAR SERN AR.

sections.title: ERN MO/SRN IL TO WRN KY
sections.text: ONGOING LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM...CURRENTLY EXTENDING FROM FAR WRN IL /INVOF BLV/ SWD TO INVOF CGI IN FAR SERN MO...SHOULD ADVANCE ESEWD THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS SRN IL AND REACH FAR SWRN IND/WRN KY BY 22Z. 20-25 KT MIDLEVEL WLY FLOW WILL MAINTAIN THE ESEWD PROGRESSION OF THIS ACTIVITY WITHIN A MODESTLY UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH MUCAPE 1000-1500 J/KG. ISOLATED STRONGER WIND GUSTS WILL BE POSSIBLE. THE 5 PERCENT SEVERE PROBABILITIES FOR HAIL AND WIND HAVE BEEN REMOVED FROM PARTS OF ERN MO WHERE CONVECTION HAS STABILIZED THE AIR MASS.

sections.title: NRN HIGH PLAINS
sections.text: EARLIER FORECASTS REMAIN ON TRACK ACROSS THIS REGION WHERE A COMPLEX TSTM/SEVERE WEATHER THREAT IS UNFOLDING AT THIS TIME. THE PRESENCE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY AND STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR WILL SUPPORT THE CONTINUATION FOR SUSTAINED/ROBUST...ROTATING UPDRAFTS. REFER TO SPC WATCH 729 AND ASSOCIATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR THE DAKOTAS...WHILE ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT IS STILL POSSIBLE ACROSS ERN MT WITH THE APPROACH OF THE UPSTREAM SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW MOVING INTO CENTRAL MT PER WATER VAPOR IMAGERY.

sections.title: ERN TX PANHANDLE INTO NWRN/WRN OK
sections.text: THE 5 PERCENT SEVERE WIND PROBABILITY HAS BEEN EXPANDED SWD TO INCLUDE MORE OF THE ERN TX PANHANDLE AND NWRN/WRN OK...GIVEN THE LOCATION OF LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE/DEVELOPING CU FIELD. A DEEP WELL MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER /SURFACE TEMPERATURES EXCEEDING 100 F/ AND MARGINAL INSTABILITY /MLCAPE 500-1000 J PER KG/ SUGGEST THE POTENTIAL FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS WITH A MORE SUSTAINED UPDRAFT/TSTM. MARGINAL INSTABILITY WILL LIMIT THE OVERALL COVERAGE FOR STRONGER ACTIVITY...AND THUS WILL NOT INCLUDE HIGHER SEVERE PROBABILITIES. ..PETERS.. 08/05/2011 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1120 AM CDT FRI AUG 05 2011/

sections.title: THERE IS A SLGT RISK OF SVR TSTMS PORTIONS NRN PLAINS
sections.text: ...SYNOPSIS... IN MID-UPPER LEVELS...DOMINANT FEATURE WILL REMAIN STG ANTICYCLONE WHOSE CENTER IS DRIFTING WWD ACROSS NE TX. WITHIN BELT OF MAINLY ZONAL FLOW TO ITS N...EMBEDDED SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER ERN MT...FCST TO MOVE ENEWD TO EWD OVER ND THROUGH REMAINDER PERIOD. WEAKER/PRECEDING SHORTWAVE TROUGH IS MOVING ENEWD ACROSS WRN SD...SWRN ND AND NEB PANHANDLE ATTM...AND SHOULD CROSS PORTIONS WRN/NRN MN BY 12Z. ALTHOUGH THIS FEATURE IS PROGGED TO CONTINUE AMPLIFYING...SOME CONVECTIVE ENHANCEMENT TO ITS VORTICITY FIELD IS POSSIBLE. 23Z SFC MAP REVEALED VERY DIFFUSE AND OUTFLOW-MODULATED FRONTAL ZONE...FROM SRN NC COAST TO OZARKS AND NRN OK...HAS BEEN MODULATED STRONGLY BY LARGE AREAS OF CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW OVER PORTIONS CAROLINAS...GA AND MS/AL. FRONT BENDS THROUGH WAVE LOW NEAR BVO WSWWD ACROSS W-CENTRAL OK AND CENTRAL/SRN PANHANDLE OF TX...LOCALLY SHUNTED SWD BY OUTFLOWS. COLD FRONT WAS ANALYZED NEAR DLH-FAR-JMS LINE...BECOMING QUASISTATIONARY WWD TO ITS INTERSECTION WITH LEADING EDGE OF MCS INVOF BIS. COLD FRONT SHOULD BECOME QUASISTATIONARY OVER ERN ND WHILE CONTINUING SWD BUT DECELERATING ACROSS NRN MN.

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: SCATTERED-NUMEROUS TSTMS ARE EVIDENT IN QUASI-LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM MOVING GENERALLY EWD ACROSS DAKOTAS ATTM...WITH PRIMARY THREAT BEING DAMAGING WINDS ESPECIALLY INVOF BOW/LEWP FORMATIONS. MRGL/CONDITIONAL TORNADO THREAT ALSO EXISTS...ESPECIALLY WITH BOW/QLCS CIRCULATIONS NEAR FRONT WHERE LIFT/VORTICITY WILL REMAIN MAXIMIZED. GREATEST POTENTIAL FOR SVR WIND WILL REMAIN ALONG AND S OF FRONT WHERE MOST FAVORABLY HIGH-THETAE INFLOW LAYER WILL PERSIST...SUPPORTING MLCAPE TO NEAR 2000 J/KG PER ACTUAL AND MODIFIED BIS RAOB. REF SPC WWS 729/731 AND RELATED MESOSCALE DISCUSSIONS FOR ADDITIONAL GUIDANCE ON NOWCAST SCENARIO FOR THIS ACTIVITY...WHICH SHOULD DIMINISH TONIGHT OVER ERN ND/WRN MN AREA AS FOREGOING AIR MASS BECOMES MORE STABLE WITH TIME AND EWD EXTENT. OTHERWISE...BKN BAND OF TSTMS CONTINUES TO MOVE ENEWD ACROSS SERN MT..WITH POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING GUSTS AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. ACTIVITY IS MOVING THROUGH POCKETS OF AT LEAST MRGLLY FAVORABLE BUOYANCY SUPPORTED TO CONSIDERABLE EXTENT BY LARGE-SCALE ASCENT IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING STRONGER/TRAILING SHORTWAVE TROUGH ALOFT. MAINTENANCE OF THIS ACTIVITY VERY FAR INTO SD...HOWEVER...IS IN AN QUESTION GIVEN THAT IT WILL BE MOVING INTO O

sections.title: SRN HIGH PLAINS...KS/OK BORDER REGION
sections.text: VERY HOT/DEEPLY-MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER WILL PERSIST FOR ANOTHER COUPLE OF HOURS S OF FRONT...WITH GRADUALLY INCREASING SFC RH NWD THROUGH FRONTAL ZONE. ALTHOUGH DEEP-LAYER WIND PROFILES AND SHEAR EACH WILL REMAIN WEAK WITH SUCH CLOSE PROXIMITY TO MID-UPPER LEVEL HIGH...MOST VIGOROUS PULSE/MULTICELL TSTMS MAY PRODUCE SVR DOWNDRAFT GUSTS AT SFC. THREAT SHOULD DIMINISH MARKEDLY AFTER ABOUT 03Z IN MOST AREAS...EXCEPT FOR LOCALIZED PERSISTENCE OF CONVECTION ALONG LEADING EDGE OF COLD POOLS POSSIBLE OVER SRN HIGH PLAINS. REF SPC MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1870 FOR ADDITIONAL DETAILS.

sections.title: SERN CONUS
sections.text: SCATTERED TSTMS IN CLUSTERS FROM ERN MS TO SC WILL CONTINUE GEN SWD SHIFT...WITH MORE DISCRETE/ISOLATED AREAS WEAKENING SOONER AND LARGER CLUSTERS PERSISTING DUE TO ASCENT OVER THEIR AGGREGATED COLD POOLS. MODIFIED BMX/JAN/CHS RAOBS SUGGEST NEARLY SFC-BASED EFFECTIVE INFLOW PARCELS CAN PERSIST FOR A FEW MORE HOURS OVER REGION...GIVEN ONLY GRADUAL NATURE OF DIABATIC COOLING PERMITTED BY SUCH RICHLY MOIST/HIGH-THETAE PRECONVECTIVE BOUNDARY LAYER. ..EDWARDS.. 08/06/2011
